New issue 83 by dou...@gmail.com: stupid documentation change
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=83

Just a trivially small thing: the appendix in the indentation on tabs vs
spaces says that the Python standard "is one or more tabs depending on
indent level." Modern Python code strongly prefers four spaces; this is
recommended eg by PEP 8
(http://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0008/#code-lay-out). The dumb attached
patch revises this.
